Help me build this properly

Does this actually solve your problem, or not?

I built this to answer one question: what percentage do I type into my slicer. But I don't know if that is where your workflow actually breaks. Tell me what is broken, missing, or just plain useless here. Honest answers, especially negative ones, are worth more to me than anything else you could do on this page.

Tell me what's wrong
Home/Support

Keep the tools free

No ads, no accounts, no paywall — the calculators stay open for everyone whether you pay anything or not. If a conversion saved you a wasted print, a tip covers the filament I burn verifying these percentages. Entirely optional.

Why I'm asking

Where it goes

Filament, hosting, domain

Every percentage on this site got printed and measured with calipers before I published it. PLA spools, test pieces, and the hosting bill are what a tip actually pays for.

What you get

Exactly what everyone gets

All of it — every calculator, guide, and dataset, free, with nothing behind a login. Your tip buys nothing extra because nothing is locked. Non-tippers and tippers get the same site.

How private

Wallet to wallet

No form, no email field, no account, no payment processor asking for ID. You send from your wallet, I receive in mine — I learn nothing about you beyond what any public blockchain transaction shows.

Send a tip

Bitcoin (on-chain)

For larger tips — confirms in about 10 minutes

bc1qnlrx0hn79ld08k0r90zl3fks29ztym9g866fcp

Check the first and last characters after pasting — wallet software mangles long strings more often than any of us would like.

The small print

No perks, no receipt, no promise

A tip is a tip: no tiers, no members-only content, no future obligations from me, and no refund path on-chain. I can't attribute a payment to you unless you tell me yourself — and I don't need you to. What I do with the site regardless of donations is written down in the Terms and Privacy Policy.

Free ways to help

Costs you nothing

  • Embed the converter on your blog or wiki — it links back to me and stays free to use.
  • Found a wrong percentage? Send a correction — fixes come from the community.
  • Tell one person whose proxies keep coming out the wrong size.
